certificate.description: FortiGate-VM 7.2/7.4 is a software module designed to execute on a General Purpose Computer (GPC) hardware platform running the VMware hypervisor. The module provides integrated firewall, VPN, antivirus, antispam, intrusion prevention, content filtering, traffic shaping, and HA capabilities.
